narrative: On the board. A clean leaf on the desk under the west window, the inkhorn capped, no words on the paper. Through the glass, the church porch, the litany letting out. No face of his. On the board. Beyond the blank leaf, a woman on the step with an older woman, a music-book under her arm, dark hair under the hood. She looks up toward the rooks. The leaf is still blank. On the board. She has crossed toward the lane the window looks on. The door to the stair is shut. He is still in the chair. The leaf has no mark.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked up from a blank leaf and did not leave the chair.

entities.name: the lady of the parish
entities.context: Came down the step with an older woman, looked up at the rooks, and crossed toward the lane. She did not speak.
